title: Salty Gillz Fishing Charters

services.name: Sight Seeing Trip
services.desc: Enjoy a nice day cruising Tampa Bay with a shaded vessel, checking out sand bars, dolphins, manatees, birds, rivers, and backcountry mangroves / bays. Half Day Trip (4 Hours): $550.00 3/4 Day Trip (6 Hour): $700.00 Full Day Trip (8 Hours): $850.00 All rates are based for up to 6 people for sand bar / sightseeing tours About Salty Gillz Charters runs out of a 224 Black Jack center console boat. The vessel also comes equipped with a large walk under bimini top for your sandbar days, to catch some shade if needed. There is also a cooler on board and ice will be provided. About Your Captain Starting at $600.00 · 4, 6 or 8 hours · Includes up to 6 passengers

services.name: Flats and Bay Trip
services.desc: We strive to work hard for you here at Salty Gillz Charters to put you on the best bite possible! Half Day Trip (4 Hours): $600.00 3/4 Day Trip (6 Hour): $800.00 Full Day Trip (8 Hours): $1000.00 All rates are based for up to 4 people. About Salty Gillz Charters run out of a 224 Black Jack center console bay boat. The boat is fully equipped for up to 4 anglers to fish comfortably (rods, reels, and tackle are provided as needed). Please notify when booking your trip if you will be bringing your own equipment. There is also a cooler on board and ice will be provided. About Your Captain Starting at $650 · 4, 6 or 8 hours · Includes up to 4 passengers · Gear Included

services.name: Tampa Bay Duck Hunting
services.desc: Join us for a Tampa Bay ducking hunting adventure, using layout boats which are low profile units to help hide from our feathery friends. These little vessels which hold up to 450 lbs sit low to the water the ducks will be flying right over you and also come face to face at times giving a very adrenaline experience that provides a great hunt. Gun and shells (steel shot) are not included with pricing, if shells are needed day of trip additional costs will apply which consist of 30 dollars a box. (please notify us before trip) When bringing your own 12 gauge shotgun, make sure the plug is in to Starting at $700 l 4 hour hunts l Options for up to 4 Hunters and multiple layout boats

services.name: Tarpon Trip
services.desc: 6- or 8-hour options on battling one of the most sought after acrobatic fish of the Gulf Starting at $950 · Includes up to 2 passengers · 6 or 8 hours · Gear Included

quotes.author: Vinny D. on Facebook
quotes.text: Captain Matt gave us an amazing experience of what the backcountry has to offer, as well as the flats. Right off the bat, he put us on a ton of snook and redfish which lasted through the entire trip. Great captain, a very down to earth guy. Can’t wait to book another trip!

quotes.author: Trevor M. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: This was the best time I've ever had fishing! My dad and I had the best time, I'll never forget this trip. Matt is an awesome fishing guide and I look forward to next time!

quotes.author: Heather J. on Facebook
quotes.text: Salty Gillz Charters was FABULOUS! I knew nothing about fishing beforehand. I learned so much, caught a lot of fish, and had lots of fun with the family!

quotes.author: Mark L. on Facebook
quotes.text: Captain Matthew Salgado will put you on the fish and is a class act. Our Snook and Reds probably totaled 25 between 3 people. Thank you Salty Gillz!

quotes.author: Jeff Stone on Facebook
quotes.text: What an amazing day on the water. Many people will fish all their lives and still not experince a day of redfish action like this on Tampa Bay.
